description: Minimal example: a single placement-recommendation virtual sensor reading conforming to the #450 schema. This is the shape sensor-gap emits for every proposed new monitoring station.

readings.notes: Proposed new monitoring station (virtual sensor). Largest sensor gap lies along bearing 330 deg from the input river point. Proposed station at 75% of the 25 km search radius along that bearing; EPQS elevation 22.4 m. Higher ground is treated as an upstream proxy (documented heuristic); true NHDPlus flowline tracing is out of scope for v0.1.
